resources.string: Tap to adjust. Uses no battery while idle.
Recommended. Puts the island above the status bar so taps, media buttons and swipes work. It reads no screen content. If the switch is greyed out: App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings.
Fallback when accessibility is off. The island shows, but the status bar takes the taps.
Shows the island above the status bar so you can tap it.

Realme Island uses accessibility only to draw the island above the status bar, so it can be tapped, and to notice when the notification shade or lock screen is open so it can hide. It does not read, collect or send any screen content.
Turn on Accessibility or Display over other apps first.
Needed to read music sessions and app notifications.
Needed to read the name and battery of your WF-C500.
Android 13+ needs this for the tiny background service notice.
Stops Realme UI from killing the island in the background.
Shows a pill around the camera hole when something happens.
Auto: wrap the camera Android reports

Drag anywhere to move the ring onto the black camera hole, then pinch or use the slider until it just fits around it. The arrows move it 1 px; hold for 5 px. The dashed outline is where the pill will sit.

Android reports a %1$d × %2$d dp box in the top %3$s corner. A camera never touches the screen edge, so that box is padding and the hole is estimated inside it. Tap Line up with camera for an exact fit.
Using your line-up: a %1$d dp camera at the top %2$s.
Always float at the top centre
Not normally needed. Auto reads the camera position and size from Android and re-fits after rotation or display changes.
Android reports a camera at the top %1$s: %2$d × %3$d dp, from the %4$s. The pill is sized around it and centred on it.
Android reports no camera at the top of the screen right now, for example in landscape. The island floats at the top centre.
Top centre is forced. Choose Auto to wrap the camera.
Animated music bars in the pill
Haptic tick when the island appears
Show live activities (stopwatch, timer, calls, downloads, navigation)
Hide while the notification shade or lock screen is open
Taps only work with Accessibility on. Without it the status bar takes the taps.

Realme UI is aggressive with background apps. For the island to survive:

• App info → Battery usage → Allow background activity
• App info → Auto-launch → on
• Settings → Battery → App battery management → Realme Island → Don't optimise
• Keep the app out of the "Lock" list in the recents screen: swipe down on the card and tap Lock.
